definitions.explanation: Plants that grow naturally in fields, mountains, and roadsides without being cultivated. Includes both flowers and grasses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道端|みちばた}→道端：28126_michibata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{野草|やそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Wild plants are blooming along the roadside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食|た}べられる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{野草|やそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{採|と}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to the mountains to pick edible wild plants.

examples.japanese: {野草|やそう}⟦{図鑑|ずかん}→図鑑：00437_zukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片手|かたて}→片手：13462_katate⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{足元|あしもと}→足元：04096_ashimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ようになる→ようになる：28408_youninaru⟧。
examples.english: When you take a walk with a wild plant field guide in hand, you start noticing the plants at your feet.

notes:
A neutral term for uncultivated plants growing in the wild. Unlike ⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧ (weeds), which has a negative nuance of unwanted plants, {野草|やそう} is more neutral or positive, treating these plants as worthy of interest.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野草|やそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{摘|つ}む→摘む：02472_tsumu⟧ (to pick wild plants)
- ⟦{食用|しょくよう}→食用：25328_shokuyou⟧{野草|やそう} (edible wild plants)
- {野草|やそう}⟦{図鑑|ずかん}→図鑑：00437_zukan⟧ (wild plant field guide)
- {野草|やそう}⟦{観察|かんさつ}→観察：02558_kansatsu⟧ (wild plant observation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {野草|やそう}: wild plant (neutral/positive, nature appreciation)
- ⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧: weed (unwanted plant)
- ⟦{山菜|さんさい}→山菜：12404_sansai⟧: wild mountain vegetables (edible, for cooking)
